payload.title: The guard could not observe the thing it forbade
payload.headline: A test titled --dry-run performs ZERO git writes asserted on a throwaway repo while its subject ran every git command in the real one: three unfalsifiable assertions, and the only falsifiable one was satisfied by the real tree ambient dirtiness.
shipped: closeout-autopilot --root with a CANON-018 refusal derived from the target own PROJECT_STATUS slug, plus a negative control proving a real run does write the aimed-at repo (D-S317.3)
the shared recipient-drain reader made exact: an empty cargo id read as drained, the one state that grants an escalation instead of prescribing a re-ship (D-S317.1)
check-cargo-silencer-census: a declared registry plus discovery over BOTH planes (source and audits/*.json); 7 declared / 7 drain-aware / 0 drain-blind (D-S317.2)
check-decision-cures accepts a comma-separated pin list (D-S317.4)
the agent/model composite recognised as an agent identity, so it cannot enter the observed-model population as a phantom model (D-S317.5)
lessons: A hand-counted denominator here has been wrong four sessions running: three cargo-attributed silencers by hand, four by the discovery pass built to check it - the missed one spells its cargo id in PROSE, not a cargoId field.
A guard that cannot observe the thing it forbids is not a guard. Write the NEGATIVE CONTROL: drive the subject in the mode that SHOULD write and prove it writes.
A propagated script resolves its root from its own location - running the  copy of ark ship delivered the cargo but chained no receipt in this repo ledger.
